newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia govt appoints chief women's adviser.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia govt appoints chief women's adviser.

text.p: The minister assisting the Australian Prime Minister for the Status of Women, Jocelyn Newman, announced on Monday the appointment of Pru Goward as the new head of the office for the status of women.
"Pru Goward is an outstanding choice to head the office of the status of women," Newman said in a statement.
"Her commitment to issues of concern to women is undoubted, evidenced by her early membership of the Womens Electoral Lobby."
The office for the status of women develops policies to protect the interests of women across government portfolios.
The office is attached to the Prime Minister's Department.
Goward is currently a political commentator for the Australian Broadcasting Corp.
